title: Accordion
description: A chevron that morphs with aria-expanded, over a panel that animates its own height.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: One accordion item
fragments.note: aria-expanded is the state. The icon reads it off the button through target.

fragments.title: Open and close on click
fragments.note: Flip the attribute, then move the text and the panel. No icon in sight.

fragments.title: Animate the panel height
fragments.note: Measure, animate, then hand the height back to the stylesheet.

fragments.title: Chevron colour, and the panel that clips
fragments.note: Colour changes at once. The shrinking panel is what hides the text.
